jobs.occupation: (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Brand Management)
jobs.description:
Nature offers increasing opportunities. Grow with us. Bionorica, with
approximately 2200 employees worldwide, is the German market leader
for pharmacy-only herbal medicines. For over 90 years, we have been
unlocking the secrets of nature by combining the knowledge of
traditional medicinal plant therapy with the forward-looking results
of scientific research. "Phytoneering” is the formula of our success
with which we have been on a growth course for years. In this way, we
open up new markets with innovative, highly effective herbal
medicines. For our location in Neumarkt (Oberpfalz), we are looking
for a: (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead (m/f/d) To strengthen
our Global Brand Management team, we are looking for a creative and
strategic (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead – Franchise Head
(m/f/d) who will take responsibility for our respiratory (Sinupret) or
women´s health (Canephron) products. These are the tasks for this
position: Development of a mid-term vision, ambition, and strategy for
our brands in the respiratory (Sinupret) or women´s health
(Canephron) products sector, taking into account country-specific
market conditions and cultural differences Design and maintenance of
brand identity, ensuring brand consistency across all channels
Responsibility for the entire brand experience throughout the product
lifecycle Conducting analysis of campaign results and consumer
insights for continuous improvement Management and maintenance of
global brand books to ensure a consistent brand presence Conducting
market and consumer research to derive actionable insights Leading the
product portfolio and lifecycle management (LCM) to maximize market
success Planning and monitoring brand budgets to ensure financial
efficiency Sharing, reusing, and leading the global brand community to
promote best practices Developing and implementing strategies to
increase brand awareness and attractiveness Creating core creative
ideas and campaigns to support our global brand strategy Defining
compelling brand stories based on deep consumer insights Close
collaboration with relevant country colleagues Depending on
experience, qualifications and organizational needs, the role may
include team leadership responsibility, contributing to the
development of franchise priorities, capability building, and the
successful delivery of business objectives These are the requirements
you should meet: Completed studies in marketing, business
administration, or similar experience Several years of experience in
brand management, ideally in the pharmaceutical or herbal sector
Proven track record in developing and implementing brand strategies
and campaigns Strong analytical skills and experience in conducting
market research Creativity combined with a strategic approach Ideally
first experiences with the "How Brands Grow" approach on
evidence-based marketing Ability to work in a dynamic international
environment and lead cross-functional teams (optional: previous
experience leading a team) Proficiency in English (both written and
spoken), basic German knowledge would be an advantage We offer you: A
globally operating, family-owned company with a commitment to social
responsibility Flexible working hours and home office options to
support the balance between work and personal life Responsible fields
of activity with a thorough onboarding process and performance-based
compensation with attractive social benefits and company pension
scheme Exciting prospects in a globally growing company with a wide
range of professional and personal development opportunities
Compensation – Global Brand Manager: Compensation is governed by the
company's collective bargaining agreement, which is aligned with the
German Chemical Industry Collective Pay Agreement (BETV Chemie). The
anticipated salary grades are: Global Brand Manager: pay grade E 10/6
K to E 12/6 K, depending on qualifications and professional experience
Senior Global Brand Manager: pay grade E 13 K The monthly gross salary
for a full-time position (39.5 hours / week) ranges from approximately
5.422 € (E 10/6 K) to 6.819 € (E 13 K), depending on the
applicable pay grade. In addition, employees may be eligible for an
above-tariff allowance, a performance-related bonus linked to target
achievement, and further benefits in accordance with company policies.
Compensation – Team Lead: This position is compensated outside the
scope of the collective bargaining agreement. The starting salary is
determined based on a current market benchmark and the candidate's
profile and is expected to range between 96.000 € and 105.000 €
gross salary per annum, depending on qualifications and experience. In
addition, employees are eligible for a performance-related bonus
linked to target achievement, as well as benefits in accordance with
company policies. Contact: Are you open to new opportunities? Then
take your chance. Please apply through our online application form. We
look forward to meeting you! Join us! Contact person Bionorica SE
People & Organisation Theresa Frank www.bionorica.de

jobs.occupation: Automotive Security Backend AI Engineer (f/m/x) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
jobs.description:
Stellenreferenz: 194945

With our brands BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce and BMW Motorrad, we are among the world's leading premium manufacturers of automobiles and motorcycles, while also providing premium financial and mobility services.

Our team is responsible for IT security across the entire ConnectedDrive Offboard Platform. We are a multidisciplinary group of internal software engineers and product owners who develop and operate cybersecurity processes and solutions, while driving IT security governance across the platform.

What awaits you?

- You develop and maintain an agentic AI toolchain for the automated vulnerability assessment of our backend systems.
- You design automated methods for identifying vulnerabilities in source code and backend functionalities using both commercial and open-source AI models.
- By expanding AI-powered analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing workflows, you continuously enhance our security assessment capabilities.
- You integrate new analysis techniques, models, and AI agents into the existing toolchain in a targeted and scalable manner.
- Through the design of intuitive frontends, you enable both security experts and software engineers to easily leverage the capabilities of the toolchain.
- You automate build, deployment, and testing processes using CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
- In addition, you implement closed-loop feedback and learning mechanisms to continuously optimize future analysis cycles.

What should you bring along?

- University degree in Computer Science or a comparable IT-related field.
- Several years of professional experience in Automotive Cybersecurity.
- Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining agentic AI toolchains using both commercial and open-source technologies.
- Experience in developing or operating complex security toolchains (e.g., static and dynamic code analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing tools).
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker/Kubernetes), as well as CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI).
- Business-fluent German and English language skills.

Are you passionate about advancing agentic AI systems for automated vulnerability assessments and actively shaping the cybersecurity of the ConnectedDrive Offboard Platform? Apply now!

Note: Please apply exclusively online via our career portal. Applications via other channels (esp. e-mail) cannot be considered.

What we offer?

- Challenging projects with which we are shaping the mobility of tomorrow together.
- Wide range of personal and professional development opportunities.
- Attractive, fair and performance-related remuneration.
- High level of job security.
- Annual special payments such as vacation pay, Christmas bonus, and profit sharing.
- Flexible working hours including 6 weeks annual leave and overtime compensation.
- Discounted BMW & MINI conditions.
- Many other benefits at bmw.jobs/benefits

Start date: from now on
Working hours: fulltime

About us At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian
EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring
learning and belonging to every child. Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19
countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance,
belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be
physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it
bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both
educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.
We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong
financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague
to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth. The Opportunity

- Account (Sales) Manager (m/w/d) We are already quite established in
Germany. With 1,500+ units already deployed nationwide with almost no
churn across strategic customers, it’s a proven, trusted, and loved
solution - used by teachers who need a reliable way to include absent
students, welcomed by families who feel their child is still
"there,” and embraced by pupils who can see, speak, and belong
again. The references are real, and the impact is repeatable at scale.
Our next chapter is expanding our footprint in Baden-Württemberg - a
strategic, organic expansion that extends what already works. It
represents a massive and vital opportunity for our mission. We’re
bringing the same quality, reliability, and outcomes that defined
success elsewhere, and we’re looking for a sales professional to
play a pivotal role in driving growth across the region. As Account
Manager, you will set your strategic focus, open executive-level doors
across education and public authorities, and orchestrate
multi-stakeholder decisions. Your craft is relationships: You’ll
cultivate a high-trust network across all your stakeholders - engaging
in person to move complex decisions forward. You will lead with rigor,
listen with empathy, and with executive credibility, you’ll turn
early wins into lighthouse references, and lay the operating cadence
that keeps momentum compounding year after year. What You’ll Do
Define and drive your territory strategy: Build and execute the
go-to-market plan for your focus area within the region -
segmentation, territory mapping, prioritizing key accounts, and
setting milestones that turn strategic goals into tangible outcomes.
Build strategic executive relationships: Build trust with education
authorities, municipal leaders, and school executives - map decision
paths, align to policy and budget cycles, and secure multi-level
sponsorship. Win and expand strategic accounts: Lead full-cycle
acquisition and growth; align executive sponsors, budget owners, and
procurement; run multi-stakeholder close plans to signed agreements.
Lead with consultative, framework-led sales: Combine solution selling
with proven methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger)
to pressure-test value, control timelines, and move from business case
to signed terms. Collaborate for seamless delivery and growth: Partner
with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure smooth
onboarding and implementation, capture outcomes, and turn success into
expansion and credible references. Create regional momentum: Build a
trusted partner network (associations, advocacy groups, integrators)
to accelerate adoption, and build visible presence by speaking at and
hosting conferences, roundtables, and policy forums to shape the
inclusion agenda. What You Bring New-business track record with
long-tail sales cycles (Germany): Solid B2B experience - creating and
closing multi-stakeholder deals, managing long cycles, and driving
consensus to close. Experience selling to the educational or public
sector will be a strong advantage. Executive relationship builder:
Ability to build credibility and earn trust from C-suite to school
leaders - advancing complex decisions through purposeful face-to-face
engagement and secure executive sponsorship. Strategic GTM & execution
discipline: Ability to build a targeted GTM strategy and turn it into
an operating rhythm - market segmentation, decision-maker mapping,
phased milestones, pipeline hygiene, and accurate forecasting
(HubSpot). Structured, consultative selling: Ability to run structured
discovery and build quantified ROI cases; experience with
methodologies such as MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN or Challenger is
beneficial. Language & location: Native-level German and professional
English; based anywhere within the Baden-Württemberg region. What We
Offer Proven platform: Expand within Baden-Württemberg with national
credibility, strong references, delivery expertise, and clear demand.
Territory ownership & autonomy: Own a key territory with significant
autonomy and decision-making responsibility. Growth & development:
Access to enablement, coaching, industry events, and opportunities to
help shape best practices as we grow in Germany. Tools &
cross-functional support: Work closely with Customer Success,
Marketing, and Product, with access to sales collateral, case studies,
and training. Scandinavian purpose-led culture: High standards,
meaningful work, and the freedom to do your best work. Highly rated
workplace: Engagement scores above benchmark, structured onboarding
with a buddy program, an annual company trip, and a collaborative
culture. Generous vacation: 27 days of annual leave plus public
holidays. Mobile & internet: Reimbursement for mobile phone and
internet subscriptions. JobAuto: Car leasing through salary sacrifice.
Annual company get-together: A yearly multi-day event focused on
connection, socializing, and memorable shared experiences.

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. About the Role We are seeking a
proactive and highly organized Administration Specialist (m/f/d) to
join our HQ office. In this role, you will be responsible for
coordinating a wide range of administrative, operational, and
organizational activities that contribute to the efficient running of
the office and support a positive employee and visitor experience. The
ideal candidate is detail-oriented, service-focused, and enjoys
managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. You will work
closely with internal stakeholders, external partners, and leadership
teams to ensure seamless administrative processes and excellent
operational support. Your Responsibilities Office Management &
Administration Manage the day-to-day administrative operations of the
HQ office Ensure the office environment is well-maintained, organized,
and fully operational Coordinate office supplies, equipment, and
vendor relationships Prepare and manage correspondence, letters, and
official documentation Maintain records, administrative files, and
internal databases Support document management and filing processes
Meeting & Event Coordination Organize and coordinate internal
meetings, workshops, training sessions, and company events Manage
meeting schedules, invitations, agendas, and logistics Prepare meeting
rooms, materials, and presentations as required Coordinate catering,
external service providers, and event-related vendors Support the
successful execution of employee engagement activities and corporate
events Travel & Logistics Management Coordinate domestic and
international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation,
transportation, and itineraries Support visitors and business guests
with travel and logistical arrangements Ensure travel documentation
and administrative requirements are completed on time Assist with
travel expense administration and reporting processes Administrative &
Operational Support Provide administrative support to management and
cross-functional teams Coordinate incoming and outgoing correspondence
and deliveries Support procurement and purchase order administration
Assist with invoice processing and vendor-related documentation
Contribute to the development and improvement of administrative
processes and procedures Stakeholder & Visitor Management Serve as a
point of contact for office-related inquiries Welcome and support
visitors, partners, and external stakeholders Coordinate
onboarding-related administrative activities for new employees when
required Foster a professional, welcoming, and service-oriented office
environment What You Bring Completed vocational training or degree in
Business Administration, Office Management, Hospitality Management, or
a related field Several years of experience in administration, office
management, executive support, or a similar role Excellent
organizational and coordination skills with strong attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high-quality
standards Strong communication and interpersonal skills Proactive,
reliable, and solution-oriented approach Proficiency in Microsoft
Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Experience
working with administrative and procurement processes is an advantage
Fluency in German and English What We Offer A diverse and impactful
role at our HQ office An international and collaborative working
environment Opportunities to contribute to office operations, employee
experience, and organizational effectiveness Professional development
and learning opportunities Flexible and modern workplace environment A
supportive team culture that values initiative, collaboration, and
continuous improvement Application Process Overview The position will
stay open until a successful candidate is chosen. Application Review:
Our team thoroughly reviews each application. Please make sure to
submit your CV in English. Initial Interview (30 minutes): Meet with
the hiring manager and HR team. Second Interview (60 minutes): Second
interview with a presentation on a relevant topic to the hiring
manager and the HR team. Offer: If successful, receive an offer to
join our team.

acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer
expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage

area) as soon as possible, we are looking for a Sustainability Data

modelling and BI solutions for organizational stakeholders Integrate

consistency, accuracy and reliability Conduct business analysis
activities to understand business user requirements and translate data

documentation for data orchestrations, highlighting their value and
contribution to improved data modeling and governance Your profile:
Bachelor's or similar degree in Data Science, Environmental Science,
Sustainability Management, or a related field, or equivalent
professional experience Proven experience with Power BI, Power
Automate, VBA, C++ programming, Python, and SAP QuickViewer Good
communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken
Knowledge of Qlik Sense and IBM Envizi is considered an advantage
Relevant experience in data analysis, reporting, and data
visualization Your perks: An interesting position with an attractive
company – recognized as a "top employer” by kununu Free parking
spaces directly next to the office and good public transport
connections Fresh fruit, water and hot beverages for free Company
fitness via "EGYM Wellpass” Bicycle leasing via "JobRad” EAP
(mental support for employees) Learning platforms such as
"GoodHabitz” and "Learn TTI” for your professional development
Special employee benefits via "Family & Friends” and additional
corporate benefit Are you interested? Then send your application via
our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your application with the
utmost discretion. We look forward to getting to know you! Techtronic
Industries ELC GmbH Human Resources – Agnese Cesarini ·
Max-Eyth-Straße 10 · 71364 Winnenden

The Solution Sales Executive (SSE) / Account Executive Specialist (f/m/d) is a strategic leader who combines deep SAP expertise, business acumen, and end-to-end solution area domain knowledge to drive LoB cloud revenue, customer success, accelerate adoption of innovation (especially AI), and position the organization as a market leader. Within the Finance & Spend Management LoB, you will be working in one of our three sales teams with a primary focus on Procurement, and be responsible for our portfolio including SAP Ariba and SAP Fieldglass. The SSE shapes transformative solutions and delivers measurable value to customers through thought leadership, innovation, and strategic execution—supporting both specific Lines of Business (LoB) and the overall “One SAP” strategy.

Key Responsibilities include

- Lead Efforts: Establish, develop, and expand market share for SAP’s Spend - Procurement solutions within named accounts in Germany
- Pipeline & Opportunity Management: Build and execute a strong pipeline for Spend to achieve the quarterly and yearly sales target.
- Account Ownership & Strategy: Serve as the LoB owner for assigned accounts, developing and executing strategic account plans that align with customer goals, business objectives and broader account plans by account team.
- Drive End-to-End Customer Value Journey with Domain Expertise: Provide solution area domain expertise and thought leadership to understand and address high-priority business challenges. Lead end-to-end process mapping and the customer value journey, owning the transformation roadmap for the LoB.
- Enablement, Demos & Prototypes: Support solution advisors to ensure demo system readiness and manage enablement programs. Collaborate with Demo & Learning teams to provide updated assets and trial environments as part of scalable enablement programs as well as customized demos, POCs and prototypes with customer specific data.
- Value Proposition & Executive Engagement: Collaborate with value advisors to create compelling narratives articulating ROI, value leakage and competitive advantages. Conduct strategic discovery, run value leakage, AOTP workshops and deliver persuasive pitches with ways of solving distinct customer business/buying-center challenges to accelerate executive buy-in and drive demand independently of RFPs.
- Commercial Negotiations: Navigate complex pricing and contractual discussions, balancing client expectations with organizational profitability and cloud revenue growth.
- Adoption & Consumption: Support Customer Success Management (CSM) communities, secure references, and manage escalations. Collaborate with CS and CS&D adoption teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions and services, monitoring outcomes and driving continuous improvement to maximize customer value.
- Customer Success & Field Impact: Own LoB deal cycles, renewals, enablement, and executive engagement. Elevate customer discussions to prioritize investment and drive measurable outcomes.
- Relationship Building & Governance: Drive C-suite engagements and Buying Center Alignment by fostering long-term high-value relationships and convert executives into advocates and brand ambassadors. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers and internal stakeholders focused on solution adoption, innovation, risks and opportunities.
- Ecosystem & Partner Engagement: Own relationships with strategic consulting partners (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY) to co-innovate, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and shape disruptive solutions. Maintain direct, high-quality relationships with partner account leads.
- Collaboration & Orchestration: Align closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to ensure SAL impact is fully integrated into the go-to-market engine with tailored GTM approach. Drive joint accountability and coordination across internal stakeholders for maximum market impact.
- Competitive & Industry Expertise: Maintain deep technical and functional knowledge across SAP solutions. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and competitive trends to craft differentiated solutions that win in the market.
